correctness.rationale: The cyclic Rule-150 kernel obeys a three-step recurrence; valid coset differences are exactly period-three 011/101/110 for lengths divisible by three. Each difference pairs \(2^m\) hard-core sources; the three directions meet only in one triple fiber. Source cardinality \(L_n\) then gives the exact whole spectrum, image and Bayesian information quantities. Squarefreeness of \(z^n-1\) for odd \(n\) proves all-time equality of kernels; a six-periodic valid vector exhibits second-time collapse on lengths divisible by six. The standalone checker exhaustively verifies lengths 3 through 18 and separate update implementations, while the written proof covers all n.
